text:
zoe_csm: Quick thread on NimbusCo renewal ask — they want a mid-term Dedicated addon (2x GPU pool) and asking for a prorated credit + seat-trueup flexibility. Account usage has been flat Q3 -> Q4.
ethan_sales: they called today; exec sponsor wants price protection and a clause to true-up seats quarterly. also asked if we can waive setup fee.
zoe_csm: they want 3-month price lock and setup fee waived if they sign by EOM. otherwise they'd default to hosted fallback.
maria_revops: waive setup fee needs signoff. we'll need invoice lines: subscription addon, one-time setup, migration labor. for revenue: recommend invoice schedule with credit memo if waiver granted.
li_legal: can we draft a short amendment that adds quarterly true-up, 30-day notice for downgrades, and a capped setup waiver? also need to check our change-in-service SLA.
sam_se: migration complexity: cross-region data move. estimate 12 engineering hours + validation tests. recommend a scheduled maintenance window 02:00-04:00 UTC, expected <60m downtime.
zoe_csm: customer requests that true-up be customer-initiated (they pay incremental seats after quarter close) but keep no negative adjustments. they don't want retroactive credits to us.
ethan_sales: commercial offer idea: 3-month price lock, setup fee waived 100% if they commit to 24 seats active within 45 days, else setup fee invoiced then. true-up quarterly, payable net30.
maria_revops: net30 ok. need PO line mapping and vendor code from their procurement. also confirm currency — they want EUR. tax implications for cross-border VAT.
li_legal: we'll add a clause: if seats < committed levels by day45, vendor-initiated rebate clause void and setup fee becomes due. also add rollback procedure and acceptance tests for post-migration perf.
finance-bot: Note: generate invoice schedule once final SOW uploaded. Currency conversion note: EUR invoices will be based on daily FX at billing date.
zoe_csm: attached: NimbusCo usage snapshot and their procurement contact (Anika). I'll send amendment draft + SOW this afternoon.
sam_se: small note: if they require dedicated in eu-west-1 we need to reserve GPU nodes — 3 day lead time for reservation.
ethan_sales: can we give them a partial migration credit (50% of setup) if they enroll in our annual enablement package? that might reduce set-up waiver ask.
zoe_csm: propose this deal: 100% setup waived if 24 seats active in 45 days OR 50% setup waived + 3 paid workshops included if they sign for enablement add-on.
maria_revops: put in writing how credits applied: either credit memo or invoice reversal. also list GL codes for revenue: SUBS_ADDON_EUR, ONEOFF_SETUP_EUR.
li_legal: please include adoption acceptance criteria: 24 seats = seats with active tokens > 50% within 45 days. define measurement method.
ethan_sales: i'll craft an email to exec sponsor with two options and proposed timelines.
zoe_csm: risk flag: adoption still low -> if they fail targets we may lose renewal. logging to QBR and flag for customer success plan.
finance-bot: e-sign queue will be triggered after amendment is signed. Reminder: PO must reference "NimbusCo PO: <number>".
zoe_csm: will share SOW + amendment v0 with Anika and cc procurement/finance. ping me if you need numeric amounts before I send.
maria_revops: ping when SOW has dollar/euro amounts. i'll draft invoice schedule and payment terms.
li_legal: once they accept, i'll fast-track redline and append to master SAAS agreement.
ethan_sales: thanks team — i'll coordinate the exec note and aim for EOM signature. :rocket:
